description: Content Scheduling - Modify Compose.tsx to properly support scheduling posts with status 'scheduled' and scheduled_for timestamp. Show scheduled posts in Drafts page with publish-now ability. The scheduling UI already exists in Compose (scheduleOpen, scheduledFor states, datetime-local input, Sheet). Drafts page already shows scheduled posts tab. This feature: ensures the Compose scheduling saves to Firestore correctly, updates Drafts to read from Firestore instead of Supabase, and adds manual publish functionality.
steps: 1. Verify src/pages/Compose.tsx scheduling flow: The insertPost function already handles status 'scheduled' and writes to Firestore 'posts' collection with scheduled_for field. This already works correctly via the existing code. No changes needed to Compose.tsx unless there are bugs.

2. Rewrite src/pages/Drafts.tsx to use Firebase Firestore instead of Supabase. Currently it uses supabase.from('posts').select() - change to query Firestore 'posts' collection where user_id == current user and status in ['draft', 'scheduled']. Use the same UI structure but with Firebase queries. The publishNow function should updateDoc(doc(db, 'posts', id), { status: 'published', scheduled_for: null }). The remove function should deleteDoc.
3. Show scheduled posts with their scheduled_for datetime clearly. Add a visual indicator (Clock icon + formatted date) for scheduled posts.
4. Add test src/pages/Drafts.test.tsx verifying the component renders correctly.
acceptance_criteria: Compose correctly saves posts with status 'scheduled' and scheduled_for timestamp to Firestore
Drafts page reads drafts and scheduled posts from Firestore (no Supabase)
Publish Now button updates post status to 'published' in Firestore
Delete button removes the post from Firestore
findings: Rewrote Drafts.tsx from Supabase to Firebase Firestore. Used two separate queries (one for draft status, one for scheduled status) since Firestore does not support 'in' operator combined with orderBy on a different field without composite indexes. Compose.tsx scheduling already worked correctly. All 29 tests pass across 7 test files.
